overlap_review_note: Equal-area check of the reviewed 77 display polygons found 65,779.597 m2 high-school overlap, 20,067.4117 m2 middle-school overlap, and 1,398.8025 m2 elementary overlap. Largest high-school pairs are Green Run/First Colonial (20,063 m2), Green Run/Ocean Lakes (16,815 m2), and Green Run/Princess Anne (15,351 m2); middle-school overlap is mainly Plaza/Independence and Plaza/Lynnhaven (about 9,694 and 9,568 m2). These official-source overlaps can affect an address near a zone edge. The 66,000 m2 cap rejects a larger change; confirm any assignment with VBCPS.

same_school_dissolves.note: The 2026-27 VBCPS locator web map uses this high-school service without a definition filter. Both FIDs have the same VBCPS SCH_ID 0010 and OBJECTID_1 14; union preserves both source footprints as one Green Run High display zone.
